brief: Trial NCT03684694 (ADC Therapeutics). Why did it stop, and was the drug it tested (loncastuximab tesirine) ever approved by the FDA, and when?

findings.claim: Trial NCT03684694 was terminated due to an "Administrative decision", categorized as business/strategic.
Trial NCT03684694 started on December 1, 2018, with a primary completion and completion date of November 8, 2022, and an enrollment of 136 patients.
Results for trial NCT03684694 were posted on ClinicalTrials.gov on February 6, 2024, with a results due date of November 8, 2023, making them 90 days late.
Loncastuximab tesirine (marketed as ZYNLONTA under BLA 761196 by ADC Therapeutics SA) was approved by the FDA on April 23, 2021.

args.sql: SELECT t.nct_id, t.title, t.sponsor, t.phase, t.overall_status, t.why_stopped, d.why_stopped_category, t.start_date, t.primary_completion_date, t.completion_date, t.enrollment, t.results_first_post_date, d.results_posted, d.results_due_date, d.days_late, t.interventions FROM trials t JOIN trial_derived d USING (nct_id) WHERE t.nct_id = 'NCT03684694'
